about.historyDescription: THINKAD, 'The Thinking Ad Agency,' is a specialized OOH agency that directly operates and manages landmark displays including COEX K-POP Square, Gangnam-daero Media Pole, New York Times Square, and Dubai Burj Khalifa LED. Headquartered in Seongsu-dong, Seoul, we continue to expand into cross-border advertising through our nationwide network and global partnerships.
